Job Description Summary:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we're looking for individuals who understand the fundamentals and principles of technology and want to solve business problems on a global scale. As the Business Analyst you’ll be responsible for evaluating technology products available in the marketplace, analyzing compatibility, expandability and ease of use. Making recommendations to management based on cost/benefit findings and participating in the development and customization of products which support our goals of becoming a platform-driven organization and drive our growth aspirations. We are looking for people that have a passion for building relationships, will be proud to be a representative of our brands, are results driven and have a deep understanding of trends and technology advancements.
What You’ll Do for Us
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve applications supporting our sales execution ecosystem.
Our platforms support critical sales capabilities including promotions, deals, sales execution, and related customer workflows . The technology landscape includes Salesforce, custom web applications, backend APIs and services, SQL Server databases, and integrations with CRM, mobile, web, and other enterprise applications.
This is not a traditional Salesforce-only development role. We are looking for a strong full-stack software engineer with meaningful Salesforce development experience who is comfortable working across the entire application and integration stack.
The ideal candidate brings strong frontend engineering skills and either Salesforce development expertise or backend/API experience, and a solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop, test, and support scalable applications supporting sales execution and customer-facing business capabilities.
Develop modern web experiences using such as React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
Preferably build and enhance Salesforce user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and related Salesforce technologies.
Develop Salesforce business logic and integrations using Apex, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform capabilities .
Preferably develop backend services and REST APIs connecting Salesforce with custom applications and enterprise systems.
Develop solutions that interact with SQL Server and other enterprise data sources.
Build and maintain integrations among Salesforce, CRM platforms, mobile applications, web applications, APIs, and backend systems .
Design reliable data flows and integration patterns between systems while maintaining clear boundaries between user experience, business services, and data layers.
Troubleshoot complex issues that span frontend applications, APIs, Salesforce, databases, and downstream integrations.
Write automated unit and integration tests and contribute to engineering quality standards.
Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.
Support automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD practices.
Partner closely with Product, Architecture, Data, QA, Security, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
Improve existing applications through modernization, simplification, performance improvements, and reduction of technical debt.
Own solutions from design through development, deployment, monitoring, and production support .
Required Qualifications
3–6 years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting enterprise applications.
Strong full-stack development experience across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
Hands-on experience developing solutions on the Salesforce platform .
Strong experience with languages like JavaScript and TypeScript .
Hands-on experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React .
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating distributed enterprise applications.
Strong backend engineering experience with a modern server-side technology such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C#, or equivalent .
Experience working with relational databases, preferably SQL Server , including data modeling, SQL development, and performance considerations.
Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts used in modern APIs and enterprise applications, including OAuth 2.0 .
Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices .
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application layers.
Ability to independently own technical solutions while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional product team.
Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Platform Developer certification or equivalent hands-on Salesforce development experience.
Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce Lightning development.
Knowledge of Apex and Salesforce application development.
Experience with SOQL , Salesforce data models, security concepts, and platform development practices.
Experience with Sales Cloud or Salesforce solutions supporting sales execution.
Experience developing applications supporting sales, promotions, deals, pricing, customer, or field execution workflows .
Experience integrating Salesforce with mobile and external web applications.
Experience with event-driven or asynchronous integration architectures.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS .
Understanding of API gateways, application security, observability, logging, and production monitoring.
Experience modernizing legacy integrations or decomposing tightly coupled applications into APIs and reusable services.
Experience working in a product-oriented engineering organization with end-to-end ownership
What We Can Do For You
Innovation & Technology: Work with an award-winning team on the cutting edge of innovation.
Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Access to global technology leaders that will expand your network and expose you to emerging technologies and techniques.
Agile Work Environment: We embrace agile, with management that removes barriers, so you are empowered to experiment, iterate, and innovate.
All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form (Form I-9) upon hire.
Skills:
Agile Methodology, Business Requirements, Communication, Computer Programming, Configuring (Inactive), Data Analysis, Financial Processing, Information Systems, Software Development, Structured Query Language (SQL), Systems Analysis, Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Teamwork, Test Environments, Troubleshooting, Waterfall Model, Workflow Management

Job Description Summary:
Individual Contributor/ Tech Lead
The Director, Cloud Architecture is responsible for leading the design and evolution of cloud architecture capabilities that enable Coca-Cola’s digital platforms and products at scale. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Cloud Platforms, this role translates enterprise cloud strategy into scalable architecture standards, solution patterns, and implementation guidance that accelerate digital delivery and modernization.
This role focuses on ensuring that cloud solutions are secure, resilient, cost-efficient, and aligned to enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and Data & AI priorities. Operating within a highly matrixed global organization, the Director will collaborate closely with platform engineering, Digital Product teams, Data & AI, and regional technology teams to drive consistent adoption of cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices
The Director will play a critical role in enabling faster time-to-market by standardizing architecture approaches, reducing complexity, and guiding the evolution of cloud capabilities that directly support business growth, operational efficiency, and innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Define, maintain, and evolve cloud architecture standards, reference architectures, and reusable solution patterns aligned with enterprise digital and data strategies.
Define integration and interoperability standards across multi-cloud environments, enterprise platforms, and business-critical applications.
Lead architecture design and oversight for cloud solutions across products and platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and security.
Establish enterprise reliability architecture standards, including service tiers, service-level indicators and objectives (SLIs/SLOs), error-budget policies, recovery objectives, capacity planning, and failure-mode analysis.
Partner with Digital Product and engineering teams to embed cloud-native architectures, including microservices, containers, and API-first designs.
Drive consistency and reuse by promoting standardized design patterns that accelerate delivery and reduce duplication across global teams.
Guide application and infrastructure modernization initiatives, including migration of legacy systems to cloud-based architectures.
Collaborate with Data & AI teams to ensure cloud architecture supports advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads
Advance Zero Trust architecture principles, platform security controls, identity-first design, and secure software supply chain practices.
Participate in architecture governance forums and review boards, ensuring adherence to enterprise standards and long-term technology direction.
Influence DevOps, automation, and platform engineering practices to improve developer experience and operational efficiency.
Define reusable observability and production-readiness patterns—including telemetry, SLO-based alerting, resilience testing, automated recovery, runbooks, and blameless post-incident learning—and embed them into cloud platforms and paved delivery paths.
Build and strengthen cloud architecture capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and adoption of modern best practices.
Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, solution design, or enterprise technology roles.
Proven experience designing and delivering cloud-based solutions in complex, matrixed environments.
Strong expertise in cloud architecture principles, including scalability, resilience, performance, and cost optimization.
Experience designing hybrid and multi-cloud architectures at enterprise scale, including SAP Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and standardization approaches.
Familiarity with Zero Trust frameworks, cloud security posture management (CSPM), and infrastructure-as-code security controls.
Experience enabling application modernization using cloud-native technologies such as containers, Kubernetes, and serverless architectures.
Demonstrated experience applying SRE and resilience-engineering practices at enterprise scale, including SLOs, error budgets, observability, production-readiness reviews, incident learning, and disaster-recovery architecture.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-relevant insights.
Demonstrated digital and data fluency, including familiarity with data platforms, analytics, and AI-driven workloads.
The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Agile Methodology, Application Development, Atlassian JIRA, Business Processes, Business Process Modeling, Cloud Platform, Communication, Data Flow Diagram, DevOps, Digital Transformation, Disaster Recovery (DR), Enterprise Architecture Framework, Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Incident Management, Java (Programming Language), Kotlin Programming Language, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Office, Microsoft SharePoint, Mobile Applications, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Resilience Engineering, Service-Level Objective (SLO), Site Reliability Engineering, User Experience (UX)

Job Description Summary:
Digital products play a central role in how we create value for customers, support our teams, and enable better decisions across Coca-Cola's North America Operating Unit.
Our Product and Engineering organizations bring together small, empowered teams that combine engineering, product, design, and data expertise to solve meaningful problems and deliver measurable business outcomes.
As a Senior Software Engineer, Financial Planning & Performance , you'll serve as the technical lead on a product team building capabilities that support how our business plans, forecasts, understands performance, and makes financial decisions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern engineering to a fascinating set of challenges where complex business logic, data, and user experience intersect. You'll help shape the technical direction, explore new possibilities, and build reliable, intuitive products that make sophisticated financial processes easier to navigate.
We're looking for an engineer who is equally comfortable discussing architecture, exploring a problem with users, challenging an assumption, and getting hands-on to build a great solution.
This role is for engineers who want to shape what gets built, not just how it gets implemented.
What You Will Work On
Financial planning is about much more than numbers. It brings together complex business relationships, assumptions, financial models, workflows, and data to help teams understand performance and make decisions.
You'll help engineer products supporting customer and commercial financial planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and performance insights. The work offers opportunities to solve challenging problems across modern application development, financial data models, business logic, enterprise integrations, and intuitive user experiences.
You'll collaborate across Product, Design, Data, Architecture, and Engineering to explore how cloud technologies, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging capabilities can create more effective ways of working.
You'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions from the earliest stages of discovery, develop scalable solutions, and establish strong engineering practices that enable products to continuously evolve.
How We Work
You'll be part of a dedicated, cross-functional product team that is:
Empowered to solve problems , not just build features
Accountable for outcomes , not just output
Collaborative by default , from discovery through delivery
Continuously learning , using data and user insight to improve
Engineering is an equal partner in product decisions. We expect engineers to bring ideas, challenge assumptions, explore possibilities, and help shape solutions from the earliest stages of discovery.
Key Responsibilities
Partner in Product Discovery & Solution Shaping
Work closely with Product Management, Design, and Data to understand user needs, business workflows, and the problems we're solving
Bring a strong technical perspective to discovery, including ideation, prototyping, experimentation, and evaluation of alternative approaches
Explore how existing platform capabilities, modern technologies, and thoughtful engineering can create better solutions
Challenge assumptions and propose approaches that simplify complexity, improve experiences, and deliver meaningful value
Help teams make informed decisions by balancing user needs, business value, technical feasibility, and long-term considerations
Lead Technical Direction & Architecture
Define and guide the technical approach, architecture, and system design for your team's products
Design scalable, maintainable solutions across applications, services, APIs, enterprise integrations, and supporting platforms
Partner with SAP specialists, architects, and other engineering teams to understand platform capabilities, constraints, and integration opportunities
Evaluate when to leverage existing enterprise capabilities, extend platforms, or build complementary applications and services
Apply modern architectural principles to create modular, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions
Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, scalability, performance, complexity, maintainability, and cost
Own Engineering Quality & Outcomes
Provide hands-on engineering leadership through solution design, development, code reviews, testing, and complex technical problem-solving
Build and deliver high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering tools and practices
Establish strong practices for automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational reliability
Ensure solutions meet appropriate standards for transactional integrity, data accuracy, traceability, and performance
Use product performance, user feedback, and operational insights to continuously improve solutions
Balance iterative delivery with long-term technical health, including proactive management of technical debt
Elevate Engineering Craft & Collaboration
Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that strengthens engineering skills, judgment, and confidence
Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, constructive challenge, and continuous learning
Collaborate with engineering leads, architects, and platform teams to share knowledge and develop reusable approaches
Contribute to engineering standards, practices, and tools that improve quality and effectiveness across teams
Support hiring, onboarding, and the development of strong engineering talent
What We're Looking For
Strong engineering fundamentals: Deep understanding of software design, modern architectures, and building reliable production systems
Full-stack technical fluency: Ability to guide development across user experiences, back-end services, APIs, and integrations
Data and analytical thinking: Comfort working with complex data models, transformations, calculations, and data-intensive applications
Product mindset: Genuine curiosity about users, business problems, and the outcomes technology can enable
Technical leadership: Sound judgment, hands-on expertise, and the ability to guide decisions without relying on formal authority
Collaborative approach: Enjoys working across disciplines and finding better solutions through shared exploration
Key Qualifications
7+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production-grade applications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Equivalent practical experience is equally valued
Strong proficiency in modern programming languages, frameworks, and full-stack application development
Experience designing and building APIs, distributed services, and cloud-based applications
Experience engineering data-intensive applications, including data modeling, integration, processing, and performance considerations
Demonstrated ability to make sound architectural decisions and balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability
Experience with modern engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and security
Track record of technical leadership, including guiding solution design, reviewing code, and mentoring engineers
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building enterprise products supporting financial planning, forecasting, performance management, or related business processes
Familiarity with financial modeling, scenario planning, forecasting calculations, or analytical applications
Experience with modern cloud data platforms, data pipelines, and enterprise data integrations
Experience developing analytical interfaces, data visualizations, or complex workflow applications
Experience working in cross-functional product teams and contributing to product discovery
Experience applying automation, AI, or advanced analytics to data-intensive products
Who Thrives Here
Engineers who:
Love solving hard problems and finding elegant solutions in complex environments
Are curious about users and the business outcomes their products enable
See established enterprise platforms as interesting engineering challenges rather than limitations
Enjoy collaborating, exploring alternatives, and challenging assumptions
Bring modern engineering thinking while remaining pragmatic about the realities of enterprise technology
Take pride in building great software, developing other engineers, and creating lasting value

Some of the most interesting engineering challenges exist where complex business processes, established enterprise platforms, and modern technologies come together. This role offers the opportunity to work in that space, bringing fresh technical thinking, strong engineering practices, and a deep understanding of users to products that operate at meaningful scale.
We're looking for an engineer who loves solving complex problems, has strong architectural instincts, and wants to influence what gets built, not just how it's implemented. Job Description Summary:
Being at the forefront of innovation is exciting and leading transformation in a large global organization is a role that many people aspire to. If this is you, we have a transformational role in our newly developed platform services organization.
Platform Engineering Lead is a hands-on engineering leader responsible for end-to-end delivery of a MarTech platform or major component within a larger product line such as Coca-Cola Consumer Data Platform (CDS) or global CIAM solution Global Access Management (GAM). Reporting to the Director, MarTech Product Development, this leader stays deeply technical, writing critical code in core services, frameworks and complex integrations during high-risk or high-visibility delivery moments, while leading a focused engineering team. The role brings AI-native practices into how the team builds, secures and operates the platform, and treats developer velocity and production reliability.
What You’ll Do for Us:
Lead end to end delivery of a high-impact MarTech / AdTech platform or component (for example, a service within CDS or GAM) while remaining deeply hands on, writing critical code in core services, frameworks and complex integrations during high-risk or high-visibility moments.
Manage and grow a focused engineering team of 6 to 10 engineers across in house and strategic vendor talent, coaching for craftsmanship, accountability and continuous learning.
Translate architecture and product strategy into executable engineering plans: define milestones, sequence dependencies, manage technical risk, and ensure predictable delivery across globally distributed teams.
Establish and enforce engineering standards and AI repository guardrails, ensuring AI-generated code is secure, maintainable, pattern-compliant, and resilient against prompt injection, unsafe dependency usage and accidental data exposure.

Job Description Summary:
The Coca-Cola Company is seeking a highly motivated Cybersecurity Auditor with a focus on Network & Firewall Management and Operational Technology (OT) to join the Internal Audit Team. This role is responsible for providing independent assurance and advisory services related to cybersecurity risks, controls, governance, and compliance, with a primary focus on network security, firewall management, and operational technology security.
The position partners with business, technology, Information Security, Risk Management, and Compliance stakeholders to assess whether network security controls effectively protect organizational assets, support regulatory requirements, and align with enterprise risk objectives.
The role also evaluates broader cybersecurity risks, including network segmentation, intrusion prevention, cloud network security, remote access security, third-party connectivity, operational technology environments, and cybersecurity governance. Experience in Artificial Intelligence governance, security, and risk management is considered a plus.
What You’ll Do for Us:
Execute risk-based audits, advisory reviews, and assessments focused on network security, firewall management, operational technology environments, network segmentation, intrusion prevention, and related cybersecurity controls.
Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls that prevent, detect, and respond to unauthorized access across enterprise networks, cloud environments, OT networks, industrial control systems, and critical technology infrastructure.
Assess the governance, administration, and security of enterprise firewalls, cloud-native network security services, network access controls, and related perimeter defense technologies.
Review firewall rule management, network configuration management, and change management processes, including provisioning, approvals, implementation, monitoring, recertification, and decommissioning activities.
Evaluate network architecture and segmentation strategies across corporate, cloud, operational technology, and vendor-connected environments to determine whether critical assets are appropriately isolated and protected.
Assess controls supporting remote access solutions, VPN technologies, third-party connectivity, internet-facing systems, DMZ environments, identity-aware network controls, and Zero Trust architectures.
Evaluate the effectiveness of security monitoring capabilities, including intrusion detection and prevention systems, network detection and response solutions, security event monitoring, logging, alerting, and threat detection processes.
Assess security controls over network infrastructure and related technologies, including routers, switches, wireless networks, load balancers, cloud networking components, industrial network devices, and supporting management platforms.
Review cybersecurity controls within operational technology environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA systems, manufacturing networks, facility technologies, and other critical infrastructure components.
Evaluate controls supporting hybrid network environments, cloud networking services, network segmentation models, and Zero Trust security architectures.
Review controls over internet-facing services, administrative network access, network service accounts, machine-to-machine communications, and vendor connectivity.
Evaluate governance and security controls supporting cloud networking, APIs, infrastructure integrations, and interconnected enterprise environments.
Assess segmentation controls, network zoning, access restriction mechanisms, and perimeter defense frameworks.
Evaluate monitoring, logging, alerting, and detective controls designed to identify unauthorized network activity, anomalous traffic patterns, potential intrusions, and network security events.
Utilize data analytics and technology-enabled audit techniques to analyze firewall rulesets, network configurations, traffic patterns, connectivity paths, security events, and anomalous network activity.
Identify control deficiencies, emerging threats, cybersecurity risks, and opportunities to strengthen network security, OT security, infrastructure resilience, and protection of enterprise assets.
Develop clear, practical, and risk-informed recommendations that enhance network security, perimeter defenses, OT security, infrastructure resilience, and overall cybersecurity maturity.
Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and regulatory developments.
Evaluate cybersecurity risks associated with digital transformation initiatives and evolving network architectures.
Consider cybersecurity implications related to cloud adoption, software-defined networking, automation, and new technologies.
Support audit coverage of Artificial Intelligence governance, AI-enabled business processes, and AI security risks when applicable.
Identify technology and cybersecurity trends that may affect organizational risk exposure.
Utilize data analytics and technology-enabled auditing techniques to enhance audit effectiveness.
Analyze firewall rulesets, network traffic, security logs, threat intelligence data, and network activity to identify risk indicators.
Leverage automation and analytical tools to improve audit efficiency and coverage.
Build collaborative relationships with Information Security, Network Engineering, Infrastructure Teams, Risk Management, Compliance, and business leaders.
Communicate audit observations and risk insights effectively to management.
Assist in preparing audit reports, presentations, and executive communications.
Support issue validation and remediation monitoring activities.

Travel: 30% domestic and international
Individual contributor role - no direct reports

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems

Experience auditing cloud network security environments such as Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud.

Job Description Summary:
Digital data products are central to how the North America Operating Unit (NAOU) Supply Chain plans, executes, and continuously improves end‑to‑end performance across sourcing, manufacturing, transportation, and customer fulfillment. Our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team builds enterprise‑scale data products that create visibility, decision intelligence, and measurable business outcomes for planning, operations, and leadership across NAOU.
We are hiring a Lead Product Data Analyst to join our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team. This role is embedded within empowered, cross‑functional product teams and partners closely with Product Managers, Data Architects, Data Engineers, Product Designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex supply chain data into trusted insights and scalable data products.
This is a Director-level role.
About the Role
Product Data Analysts are core contributors to the design, development, and adoption of supply chain data products. In this role, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, helping teams understand operational performance, evaluate opportunities, and measure outcomes across the end‑to‑end supply chain.
You will lead sophisticated analyses, shape data models and metrics, and influence prioritization and trade‑offs by grounding decisions in data. Beyond executing analysis, you will help elevate analytical standards across the organization by modeling strong analytical practice, strengthening measurement discipline, and enabling self‑service insight for product teams and stakeholders.
This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives at the intersection of supply chain operations, data engineering, and advanced analytics—turning complex, multi‑source operational data into clear insight, reliable reporting, and decision‑ready products.
What You Will Do
Supply Chain Analytics & Insight
Develop a deep understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain processes and data, including procurement, manufacturing, inventory, transportation, and customer fulfillment.
Analyze large, complex datasets to identify performance drivers, risks, trade‑offs, and improvement opportunities across planning and execution.
Translate operational and optimization data into actionable insights that inform product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business priorities.
Go beyond describing what happened to explain why it happened and what actions should follow.
Proactively surface insights that help teams focus on the highest‑value opportunities.
Informally mentor analysts and partners through collaboration, review, and shared best practices.
Data Product Development & Measurement
Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define product objectives, success metrics, KPIs, and outcome‑based measures.
Design, maintain, and document analytical models, metrics, and business logic that support scalable data products and decision intelligence.
Support movement from static reporting toward reusable, trusted data assets and analytical products.
Advise on the appropriate level of analytical rigor based on decision risk, business value, and operational impact.
Data Quality, Modeling & Integration
Work closely with data architect and data engineering teams to define, validate, and evolve data models in Microsoft Azure.
Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned to supply chain process realities.
Act as a steward of data quality, metric definitions, and analytical assumptions across products.
Document data logic, metrics, and methodologies to support transparency, reuse, and auditability.
Insight Communication & Influence
Create dashboards, analytical views, and narratives that make complex supply chain data accessible and actionable.
Communicate insights clearly to technical and non‑technical audiences, including supply chain leaders.
Contribute to a data‑informed culture by raising analytical fluency across supply chain product teams.
Collaborate with other analysts, data architects, data engineers, and data scientists to align insight across domains.
Tools & Technologies
This role will actively use and support data products built on:
Microsoft Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric.
PySpark Notebooks for data exploration, transformation, and analysis.
Microsoft Azure Pipelines for analytics workflows and data product deployment.
SQL‑based analytics across large‑scale enterprise datasets.
Visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI.
What You Will Need
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, industrial engineering, supply chain, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence supporting complex operational or supply chain domains.
Advanced SQL querying and mastery of Python or another scripting language, including PySpark.
Extensive experience working with supply chain data from systems such as SAP S/4HANA (e.g., procurement, inventory, planning, manufacturing, order‑to‑cash), Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and other supply chain systems.
Statistical methods and modeling techniques, with working knowledge of machine learning models.
Data quality assessment, validation, and root cause investigation.
Proven ability to influence decisions through data and clear communication.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working within cross‑functional product or platform teams.
Ability to work independently and to foster a data-driven culture of growth.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in a related quantitative or supply chain field.
Experience supporting enterprise‑scale supply chain data platforms or analytics products.
Experience applying forecasting and optimization modeling to supply chain planning, execution, or operational decision-making.
Knowledge of Azure and Microsoft Fabric storage and compute concepts that support scalable analytics products.
Skills
Analytical Rigor: Breaks down complex operational questions into clear, structured analyses using SQL, scripting, statistical methods, and root cause investigation.
Supply Chain Acumen: Understands end‑to‑end supply chain processes and metrics.
Product & Systems Thinking: Connects data insight to scalable data products and business outcomes.
Data Storytelling: Communicates insights with clarity through visuals and narratives.
Collaboration & Influence: Builds trust across supply chain, product, and technology partners.

Job Description Summary:
Digital products play a central role in how we create value for customers, support the teams who serve them, and shape the consumer experience. Our product organization brings together small, empowered teams that move with clarity, speed, and purpose, making digital a meaningful source of advantage across our operating unit.
Our work spans the experiences that keep the business running, including customer journeys, service delivery, sales workflows, and the systems that connect them. If you are energized by solving real customer problems, partnering across functions, and shaping products that deliver measurable impact, this role is for you.
About the Role
We are hiring a Lead Product Data Analyst to join our Digital Product Data & Analytics team within the North America Digital & Data organization. Reporting to the Head of Product Data & Analytics, you will join a team of product data analysts and data scientists embedded within empowered, cross-functional squads that partner closely alongside Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and business stakeholders.
In this role, you will help define product outcomes, develop and test hypotheses, and influence prioritization and trade-off decisions across the product roadmap. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy in complex and ambiguous problem spaces. Beyond delivering analyses, you will play a critical role in building the discipline of product analytics by bringing advanced methods, strong product thinking, and creative problem-solving to the enterprise.
This role is a strong fit for an analyst who enjoys working closely with product teams, is curious about how users behave, and is motivated by helping teams learn faster and make better decisions.
What You’ll Do
Product Analytics & Experimentation:
Define and evolve product measurement strategies and success metrics across adoption, engagement, retention, product health, and value creation.
Analyze product usage, funnels, customer journeys, and segments to uncover user behaviors, friction points, trends, and opportunities that inform product strategy and iteration.
Apply advanced analytics, statistical methods, and experimentation, including A/B testing, incrementality testing, and quasi-experimental analysis, to understand product performance and quantify impact.
Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Commercial, and Operations to translate insights into product strategy, priorities, and action.
Develop scalable measurement frameworks, playbooks, and experimentation standards that strengthen analytical maturity and outcome-based decision-making across teams.
Instrumentation & Data Quality:
Define and improve product instrumentation, event tracking, and data structures that accurately reflect user behavior and support product measurement.
Partner with Application Engineering to implement and validate event instrumentation, ensuring product interactions are captured accurately and consistently.
Partner with Data Architecture and Data Engineering to define data requirements and ensure product data flows into the data lake.
Establish and maintain consistent metric definitions, data-quality standards, and analytical assumptions across products.
Communication & Influence:
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data narratives that make insights accessible and actionable.
Translate complex quantitative findings into clear recommendations that influence product strategy, prioritization, and decisions.
Champion the thoughtful, ethical, and high-quality use of data across the product organization.
What You’ll Need
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in analytics, statistics, biostatistics, data science, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in advanced analytics or applied data science supporting digital products in B2B or B2C marketplaces.
Strong foundation in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical methods
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with experience working with large, complex datasets using Microsoft Azure technologies such as Synapse, Fabric, and PySpark notebooks.
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence product strategy and decisions.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and foster a data-driven culture of learning and growth.
Preferred Qualifications

Job Description Summary:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we are connecting the power of technology with the scale of our global operations to create secure, digitally confident systems that drive growth. Cybersecurity is at the heart of this commitment, ensuring our platforms, data, and operational environments remain protected as we transform in an increasingly complex and connected world.
We are seeking an Information Technology Auditor with deep cybersecurity expertise to join our Internal Audit team. This role is integral to safeguarding enterprise resilience by assessing technology controls across cloud platforms, digital ecosystems, industrial control systems, and data privacy frameworks. You will serve as a Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expert (SME), partnering closely with senior IT and security leaders to identify emerging risks, evaluate control strategies, and ensure compliance with globally recognized standards, including SOX requirements.
If you have strong technical curiosity, proven experience in IT audit or cybersecurity, and a passion for applying risk-based thinking to dynamic technology environments, this opportunity offers a unique platform to influence operational integrity across a company that refreshes the world every day.
What You’ll Do for Us
Serve as an internal Cybersecurity SME within the Internal Audit function, conducting audits and advisory activities related to cybersecurity, IT compliance, and technology risk.
Develop audit strategies for technology-focused engagements by contributing methodologies, risk-based approaches, and alignment with prior audit results.
Perform interviews with process and business owners to gather insights on operational practices, expected controls, and areas of potential vulnerability.
Independently execute established audit tests to evaluate effectiveness of security measures, IT controls, and governance processes across global environments.
Apply frameworks such as NIST, PCI, COBIT, and others to assess cybersecurity posture and recommend control enhancements.
Analyze findings using professional skepticism and risk-awareness; document judgment-based conclusions and ensure recommendations address root causes effectively.
Prepare detailed audit reports communicating observations, risk implications, and corrective actions in an accurate and concise format.
Collaborate with IT leaders and stakeholders on remediation plans for identified gaps, ensuring alignment with business priorities and compliance standards.
Maintain awareness of evolving technologies—cloud services, ERP platforms, industrial control systems—and emerging cybersecurity threats to inform audit scope and focus.
Participate in continuous improvement of audit methodologies and contribute ideas for leveraging analytics and automation within audit processes.
Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, or related discipline.
3–4 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, security engineering, or technology-focused public accounting engagements.
Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM preferred; additional technical credentials (e.g., CEH, OSCP) advantageous.
Strong knowledge of IT control frameworks (COBIT, PCI DSS, NIST) and ability to apply them in risk-based auditing environments.
Familiarity with technologies such as SAP ECC/HANA, SAP GRC, Active Directory, RedHat Linux, Windows OS, Oracle Database, MS SQL Server, AWS, Azure Cloud, Microsoft 365, Palo Alto Networks, and network/ICS equipment.
Understanding of general IT control principles including security operations, system administration, program governance, change management, and privacy standards.
Proficiency across modern development models (DevOps, Agile) and awareness of data governance and incident management processes.
Strong analytical and quantitative ability; comfortable working with probabilities, ratios, and statistical measures to identify risk trends.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to clearly present risks, negotiate corrective actions, and engage stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally; flexibility to accommodate department needs and extended projects.
Demonstrated initiative and aptitude for learning new technologies and adapting to evolving business environments with minimal supervision.
